newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds close buoyed in line with Europe.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds close buoyed in line with Europe.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed well-supported in sympathy with other European markets and 10-year bond yields sank to record lows below eight percent, dealers said.
They said bond prices could continue their upward march tomorrow led by Bonos.
"The market is very well-supported, both in futures and cash," said one operator during late afternoon trade.
Dealers said optimism that Portugal would qualify to join the European single currency was boosting the market.
Money rates eased, raising expectations that the Bank of Portugal could trim key rates soon, dealers said. One month money stood at 7.08/7.12 percent, compared with 7.08/7.15 percent at the opening.
